source.name: Microsoft Excel functions (alphabetical)
source.scope_note: Official index applies to Microsoft 365 and also lists supported legacy Excel versions; function version markers are copied exactly when present.
caveats: Microsoft documents its available products and introduced-version markers on the index, but does not provide a current build, update-channel, or tenant-rollout matrix; Excel 365 desktop availability is therefore unknown in this inventory.
Function names grouped in one Microsoft table row are emitted as separate entries and linked with source_name_group; this does not assert that they are semantic aliases.
Descriptions are intentionally omitted. Category labels are copied from the source table, including source spelling variants.
